text:
alex: Kicking off SI activation — calling this the 'greenroom' sprint. Need one lightweight checklist that covers: training cohort plan, HW voucher distribution, cloud marketplace listing steps, and joint announcement timing. Target: enable Cohort 0 by 2026-05-12. Who can own each pillar?
priya: I can own training & cohort ops. plan to run 2 half-day sessions + 1 hands-on lab. Need mentor pairing and grading rubric.
ben: I'll handle HW voucher logistics with hw partners. Question: how many voucher seats for cohort 0? Recommend 30.
taylor: I can lead marketplace listing + docs. Need the SKU and pricing tier from product to finish the listing metadata.
sam: I'll coordinate the joint announcement & PR timeline. We should avoid syncing with partner A's own launch week (they said mid-May).
alex: Great. Priya — can you draft session outlines + sample checklist by EOD Tuesday? Ben — confirm voucher flow + expiry policy. Taylor — can you map the marketplace task list (legal + billing + icon) and drop into the doc? Sam — I'll pull the announcement blackout windows from partner A and draft a micro-PR calendar.
priya: Outline draft posted: https://tiny.redwood/si-greenroom-outline (still WIP). Key ask: 2 mentors per pod, 1 technical exercise (deploy sample app to VPC private deploy).
ben: Voucher flow: partner HW team will ship 1-week loaner kits. Ops command to allocate vouchers we tested: ```/voucher allocate --partner si-acme --qty 30 --expires 2026-06-01``` Need CLAs signed before kit release.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace checklist template created: https://intranet.redwood/marketplace-templates/si-listing. Steps: SKU + pricing, security questionnaire, billing account mapping, icon + screenshots, EULA.
taylor: Noted. I need SKU from product. @alex who owns SKU mapping?
alex: @taylor Product: priya will ping product-ops; I'll loop in sean from product.
priya: Pinging product-ops now — please add any required compliance items for private deployments.
sam: Announcement plan: short partner blog + joint webinar. Proposed webinar date: 2026-05-18 (one week after cohort start). If partner A prefers earlier, we can flip. Need speaker list and 2 rehearsals.
ben: Logistics question — loaner kits need onsite contacts for shipping. I have a template email.
aylor: Marketplace listing needs a short technical validation doc. I'll draft an 'SI-ready' checklist of supported deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private).
alex: Good. Also want a simple ramp scorecard for SI readiness: training completion, lab success (deploy + inference smoke test), marketplace listing complete, CLA signed. Targets: 80% pass to be certified.
priya: Agree to 80% pass for cohort 0, with remediation week. For assessment we'll use 10-question lab exercise + one proctored live run.
sam: Who will host the proctoring? Can ops-proctoring tool do it or do we need Zoom + recorded session?
ben: Ops can run remote proctoring via our internal tool. I'll confirm.
aylor: I'll add marketplace status column to the tracker.
alex: Action items summary: Priya — session outlines + rubric (due Tue). Ben — voucher flow + shipping contacts + proctor confirm (due Tue). Taylor — marketplace task list + validation doc (due Wed). Sam — announcement calendar + speaker list (due Wed). I'll create the master tracker.
priya: +1. Also request: mentor pairing names by Wed so mentors can prep.
marketplace-bot: Created tracker: https://tracker.redwood/si-greenroom-2766000000 (editable by partnerships, product, eng-ml).
sam: Quick ask — do we want a small press embargo language? I can draft one-liner to share with partner legal.
alex: Yes, please draft embargo language and send to partner legal loop.
ben: I'll drop the shipping template and CLA link into the tracker.
priya: Thanks team. excited to run cohort 0. :rocket:
alex: Thanks all — weekly check on Wednesdays 10am PT until launch. I'll post calendar invite. :calendar:
